Want free, renewable power? Solar Panels generate RF from direct sunlight and output to a Forge Power Output Hatch on their bottom face. They're the primary power source for surface-based AR machines.

The panel needs a clear sky view to work. Underground, under a roof, or at night drops output to zero. Output scales with the planet's insolation multiplier, so panels work better on some worlds than others.

A Solar Array Panel gives you 8x solar panels in a 3×3 pattern with a Structure Tower at center. Chain panels side-by-side and connect via Tesseract or EnderIO Power Conduit for long-distance transmission.

§ePS:§f Build the Solar Array Panel for better panel density. For night-time backup, pair with a Fusion Reactor or switch to the Black Hole Generator (10083) for endgame power.
